title: 'Ghost' caught on camera knocking over sculptures leaves homeowners 'spooked'
excerpt: A Dorset gift shop owner was left baffled after a three-foot-tall Buddha statue was found toppled over, but after checking CCTV, she discovered the culprit.
content:
Faye Mayern, Brigid Brown

Sun, September 6, 2026 at 10:00 AM UTC

A gift shop owner who suspected paranormal activity discovered a "ninja" hedgehog wreaking havoc in her yard during the nighttime hours.

Rachel Eaton was shocked when her 3.2ft tall Buddha statue was discovered toppled on August 25. The following day, Eaton and her team at Curiosity Swanage in Dorset found additional sculptures knocked down and considered it "a bit spooky."

Yet, upon reviewing CCTV footage, Eaton identified the perpetrator as a spiky trespasser - a female hedgehog who had been racing through her shop.

"She was nicknamed 'Ghost' by the rescue who came and collected her but she started off as Houdini."

"The hedgehog was a bit bruised from her Mission Impossible adventure."

In the video footage, the hedgehog can be observed jumping between ceramic planters and darting across the shop yard floor. The Buddha statue can be seen wobbling before falling forward with "Ghost" to blame. Eaton added: "We thought it was a bit odd there wasn't more devastation if it was the wind." DON'T MISS:

"It was the next day we saw the ninja hedgehog. I phoned Dorset Hedgehog Rescue after telling the [shop] girls we couldn't keep her as a pet."

Ghost was transported for an examination, where she was found dehydrated and slightly bruised.

She has been released for rehabilitation near Dorchester.

"It was when we checked the CCTV that we saw Buddha walking itself off the platform. It was a bit spooky."
